496 |     /// @param _nftIndex The NFT to return credit limit of
   497 |     /// @return The NFT credit limit
   498 |     function _getCreditLimit(uint256 _nftIndex)
   499 |         internal
   500 |         view
   501 |         returns (uint256)
   502 |     {
   503 |         uint256 asset_value = _getNFTValueUSD(_nftIndex);
   504 |         return
   505 |             (asset_value * settings.creditLimitRate.numerator) /
   506 |             settings.creditLimitRate.denominator;
   507 |     }

525 |     /// @return The outstanding debt value
   526 |     function _getDebtAmount(uint256 _nftIndex) internal view returns (uint256) {
   527 |         uint256 calculatedDebt = _calculateDebt(
   528 |             totalDebtAmount,
   529 |             positions[_nftIndex].debtPortion,
   530 |             totalDebtPortion
   531 |         );
   532 | 
   533 |         uint256 principal = positions[_nftIndex].debtPrincipal;
   534 | 
   535 |         //_calculateDebt is prone to rounding errors that may cause
   536 |         //the calculated debt amount to be 1 or 2 units less than
   537 |         //the debt principal when the accrue() function isn't called
   538 |         //in between the first borrow and the _calculateDebt call.
   539 |         return principal > calculatedDebt ? principal : calculatedDebt;
   540 |     }

407 |     /// @dev Returns the value in ETH of the NFT at index `_nftIndex`
   408 |     /// @param _nftIndex The NFT to return the value of
   409 |     /// @return The value of the NFT, 18 decimals
   410 |     function _getNFTValueETH(uint256 _nftIndex)
   411 |         internal
   412 |         view
   413 |         returns (uint256)
   414 |     {
   415 |         bytes32 nftType = nftTypes[_nftIndex];
   416 | 
   417 |         if (nftType == bytes32(0) && !daoFloorOverride) {
   418 |             return
   419 |                 _normalizeAggregatorAnswer(
   420 |                     useFallbackOracle ? fallbackOracle : floorOracle
   421 |                 );
   422 |         } else if (nftType == CUSTOM_NFT_HASH) return nftValueETH[_nftIndex];
